The '''Agricultural research vessel''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used for research of agriculture. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] one such vessel was hijacked on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Slak Sagar]]. Sagar worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and used the vessel to test a new drug on scientists, until it was destroyed by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] mercenary [[Rianna Saren]].<ref name="LA" />
